Navigation that stays out of the way

The sidebar carries your company brand, a Search trigger, every installed app, and the active app opened to its full menu tree. Collapse it to an icon rail with the header button or Ctrl + B — the choice is remembered per browser. On desktop the navbar hamburger and section dropdowns step aside, so there is exactly one way to navigate instead of three.

Keyboard first

Ctrl + K opens Odoo's own command palette, restyled to match: hairline borders, soft shadow, Inter throughout. Same behavior your users already know, without the visual noise.

Dark mode, including on Community

One click in the systray switches the whole backend to a full Linear dark palette — lists, forms, kanban, modals, chatter and the palette included. Odoo Community ships no dark mode at all; this module adds it. On Enterprise it integrates with the native color-scheme setting, so the choice survives a reload instead of snapping back to your system preference.

Your color, not ours

Pick the accent on the company form — Settings → Users & Companies → Companies — so each company in a multi-company database can have its own. Buttons, active menu entries, links and highlights follow it, and a matching variant is used in dark mode so contrast stays right in both.

Questions

Is there a different version for Community and Enterprise?
No. It is a single module. It detects the edition at runtime and adapts.
Does it break my other modules?
It restyles Odoo's own components and adds one sidebar; it does not replace views or actions. Anything built on standard Odoo widgets inherits the styling automatically.
Can I uninstall it cleanly?
Yes. Uninstalling removes the assets and returns the backend to stock Odoo. Nothing is written into your business data.
Does it work on mobile?
Below 992px the sidebar hides and Odoo's standard mobile navigation takes over, so phones and tablets keep the behavior your users expect.
Does it need the Website app?
No, it depends only on web. If you happen to have website installed, its own login layout takes over and the sign-in screen may not look right — write to support@simplifyit.com.bo and we will send you the free simplifyit_linear_backend_theme_website add-on.
Is the font loaded from a CDN?
No. Inter is bundled inside the module as a variable WOFF2, so nothing is fetched from an external server and the backend works offline.
